Full job description

Key Responsibilities

Design, train, and deploy machine learning models for healthcare applications using Azure Machine Learning or Google Vertex AI.
Develop AI copilots and intelligent agents using Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LangGraph.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrated with vector search platforms such as Azure Cognitive Search, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
Develop secure, responsive web and mobile applications using React, Vue, or React Native.
Build and maintain APIs and backend services that integrate ML models with enterprise systems.
Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures in Azure SQL or Google Cloud SQL.
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure using Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions, Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
Implement CI/CD pipelines through Azure DevOps or Google Cloud Build.
Ensure all applications and data pipelines comply with HIPAA standards and safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI).
Collaborate with product, compliance, and engineering teams to deliver secure, audit-ready AI solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in machine learning or AI application development.
2+ years of experience in a HIPAA-compliant or healthcare environment.

Proficiency in:

Machine learning platforms (Azure ML or Vertex AI)
AI frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or LangGraph)
JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or React Native)
Serverless cloud functions (Azure or Google Cloud)
SQL (T-SQL, stored procedures, performance tuning)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR).
Familiarity with vector databases, RAG pipelines, and OpenAI APIs.
Knowledge of MLOps tools, Infrastructure as Code, and workflow automation (n8n).

Core Competencies

Security and compliance mindset
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Effective communication across technical and non-technical teams
Ability to manage priorities independently in a fast-paced environment
